# Week 3: Regularisation

## Dropout

Dropout randomly zeroes a fraction of activations during training, which stops units
from co-adapting and acts as an ensemble of thinned networks. At test time all units are
kept and activations are scaled accordingly.

## Weight decay

Weight decay adds a penalty proportional to the squared weights (L2) to the loss, which
pulls weights towards zero and reduces overfitting.

## Early stopping

Early stopping halts training when the validation loss stops improving, which limits
overfitting without changing the model.
